notes: Hybrid v1.3: the event-tokenized pair (orchestration/docs/model_specs/event_pair_proposal.txt). Model 1 event (continuation_events_m1e_r1_kv, vocab 12024: ON = time, note, vel; OFF = time, 11768 + note) while the piano is silent; model 2 event (simultaneous_events_chordtokens_m2e_r1_kv, vocab 14328, OFF0 14071, STACK_OFF 14327) while it plays; v1.1's switching rules. Piano key-down / key-up are ON / OFF events at once (no duration estimates). Sampling rule (spec 8): a piano token after a drawn time is a no-op and the next time is later; after forceAfterMs of orchestra silence the piano tokens are masked. Model 2 draws nothing for the first startDelayMs. First version: model 2 draws ON / OFF events only (its WAIT / chord tokens are masked).
